description: Pax于1952年推出的旁轴相机。配备Luminor Anastigmat 1:3.5 F=45 mm; a coated triplet.。使用24x36mm on 135 film.。**Knurled finger-knob on lens. Scale in feet, from 3 ft to infinity.。

specs.英文简介: The Pax 35 is the first in the Pax series of compact fixed-lens 35 mm rangefinders made by Yamato from 1952-55.McKeown p.1022 It was named Pax 35 on the original box & instructions.McKeown p.1022 The styling recalls a Leica II or III, but it is a much smaller and simpler camera.
